name: Gabino Palomares
description: '''Gabino Palomares Gómez'''{{Family name footnote|[[Palomares (disambiguation)|Palomares]]|[[Gómez]]|lang=Mexican}} (26 May 1950 – 30 September 2026) was a Mexican singer-songwriter and a social and political activist. He was one of the main exponents of the [[nueva canción]] movement in Latin America, and one of the founders of the [[canto nuevo]] movement in Mexico, alongside [[Amparo Ochoa]], [[Óscar Chávez]], and the group Los Folkloristas. He was the author of "{{ill|La maldición de Malinche|es}}" ({{translation|"Malinche's Curse"}}, 1978), one of the most prominent songs of the movement, and of more than a hundred songs covering social, political, and love themes.
